scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof and supplementary finite checker. No claim of independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Schatten-class weighted partial-permutation operators; it does not resolve the all-compact-operator Schatten endpoint. No distribution-independent convergence rate. A related historical bilateral-shift calculation covers a stretched-exponential family, not arbitrary summable weights. Priority remains subject to further literature verification.
title: Endpoint Schatten convergence for bilateral shifts and weighted partial permutations
